title: C4OS Grill Question 036A - Document Preview Plugin Boundary

questions.label: Who should own document preview support in C4OS v1?
questions.help: Recommended: document-family plugins own document-specific preview behavior. Browser may display rendered output, but Browser does not own office document support.
options: Document-family plugins own previews; Browser can host rendered output
Browser plugin owns all document previews
One generic Document Preview plugin owns every document type
Defer document preview support from v1

questions.label: Which document-family plugins should be planned first?
questions.help: Recommended: plan Documents and Spreadsheets first because the original task named .docx and .xlsx. Keep Presentations and advanced PDF as later plugin work unless explicitly prioritized.
options: Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, and PDF together
PDF first, then office document plugins

questions.label: How should PDF be treated in the first pass?
questions.help: Recommended: Browser can use native PDF viewing for simple preview, while a PDF plugin owns advanced read/create/render/verify workflows later.
options: Browser-native PDF preview first; advanced PDF plugin later

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether previews need editing, attachment creation, conversion proof work, sandbox constraints, or provider-specific runtime behavior.
